library_preparation_preflight.summary: Pure Jackson/HTTP REST client (JinaEmbeddingModel, JinaScoringModel) with no extra runtime deps. Jina's API is a paid cloud service with no freely-pullable Docker image, but both model builders expose baseUrl(...), so the generated test can fake the endpoint locally like 37+ other modules in this repo already do.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Fake the Jina REST endpoint locally (as this repo already does for other HTTP-client libraries, e.g. zipkin-sender-okhttp3, maven-resolver-transport-http, jwks-rsa) using the JDK-bundled com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer to serve a canned JSON response, then point the client at it via JinaEmbeddingModel.builder().baseUrl("http://localhost:<port>/") or JinaScoringModel.builder().baseUrl(...) with a dummy non-blank apiKey and modelName. No real network call or API key is needed. Exercise both JinaEmbeddingModel (embed) and JinaScoringModel (score/rerank) to cover the request/response DTOs in dev.langchain4j.model.jina.internal.api, matching the 12 types Micronaut's reachability-metadata.json already covers.
risks: Jackson deserializes response DTOs reflectively, so the fake server's JSON payload must match the real Jina response shape closely enough to populate every field the agent should trace, or some reflect-config entries will be missed.
No free Docker image exists for Jina's models (commercial on-prem license or cloud marketplace only), so if local HttpServer faking later proves insufficient, there is no low-effort Docker fallback.
